summary: Source inspection confirmed that the MLX auxiliary-state component bypassed MambaComponent initialization without supplying its inherited checkpoint-grid and path-cap fields. The request pool already had the mamba_allocator alias, but MLX still lacked CUDA's deferred CoW application. The candidate initializes the inherited fields and copies a matched auxiliary snapshot into the request slot synchronously. Apple MLX execution was unavailable in this Linux ROCm environment.

tests.what_was_measured: Modified production and regression-test modules compile successfully.
Test collection succeeded; all 41 tests were skipped because the prepared Linux environment has no mlx package. Raw output: reports/j-4d61677d330e/raw/mlx_unit.log

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect is specific to Apple's MLX backend. The assigned gfx950 ROCm GPU cannot execute MLX and would not validate the reported path.

remaining_limitations: No Apple Silicon or mlx Python package was available, so the new MLX regressions and an end-to-end hybrid-SSM serving request could not be executed.
No model weights were used; semantic model accuracy and serving behavior remain unverified.
The candidate is supported by direct source-contract evidence and compilation, not runtime MLX validation.
